propositions: model_max_output_tokens function lacks Amazon Nova model entries, causing Bedrock calls to fail with ValidationException when output tokens exceed the 10k ceiling
Bedrock Nova models (pro, 2-lite, lite, micro) have a maximum output token limit of 10,000 but the current lookup table only knows Claude models and falls back to 16,000
Plan-review LLM phase becomes INDETERMINATE when Nova models are used without proper ceiling configuration because Bedrock rejects requests exceeding model limits
Substring matching in model_max_output_tokens requires explicit entries for nova-lite and nova-2-lite forms to avoid false mismatches in the lookup table
Adding Nova family entries to MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS with 10,000 token values will allow Nova models on Bedrock to complete successfully in rebar workflows
